items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: Yeah, see I only heard him once. Live. And that was at his club, the new club downtown.

ctx.x: I used to buy a lot of Condon records. Of course I used to hear Condon live on the record.
Yeah, see I only heard him once. Live. And that was at his club, the new club downtown. But I listened to his band whenever possible, you know, on records.
Oh yeah. Well, he was a great spokesman during that time.
